# Archie bridges

<!-- Generated by `archie-bridges index`. Edit bridges/<id>/bridge.toml or the tools, not this page. -->

A bridge drives one application through its own free, official automation surface — a CLI, its file format, an IPC API — as MCP tools confined to one folder. Read a bridge's guide before its first call: `archie_bridge_guide {"bridge": "<id>"}` over MCP, or `bridges/<id>/SKILL.md`.

## Connecting

Any MCP client (Claude Code, Codex, an IDE, Archie's own planner) starts the server with the bridges it wants and the folder each works in:

```bash
archie-mcp-server --clearance internal --bridge kicad=/home/me/pcb --bridge video=/home/me/media
```

Claude Code: `claude mcp add archie -- archie-mcp-server --clearance internal --bridge kicad=$PWD`.
From a shell, without MCP: `archie-bridges call kicad kicad_projects '{}' --workspace DIR`.

`--clearance internal` is needed because these tools carry file names; use it only with a model whose provider's retention you have checked, or a local one.

## Tools first, eyes second

Use the tools for what they cover: they are exact and cheap. Operate the application's window on the Archie Stage for the rest, and check that work with the bridge's reads and renders instead of by looking. Each bridge says below when the GUI is the way.

## Bridges

| Bridge | Application | What it does | Programs |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`kicad`](#kicad) | [KiCad](https://www.kicad.org) 10.x (kicad-cli since 7; pcb render since 9) | Read schematics and boards, run KiCad's ERC and DRC, set part fields, export fabrication files and render boards. | `kicad-cli` |
| [`video`](#video) | [MLT (Kdenlive, Shotcut)](https://www.mltframework.org) MLT 7.x | List and probe media, then render a timeline of cut clips, titles, music and fades to MP4, with a Kdenlive-openable project beside it. | `melt`, `ffprobe` |

### kicad

Read schematics and boards, run KiCad's ERC and DRC, set part fields, export fabrication files and render boards.

- Works in: A folder of KiCad projects: .kicad_pro with their .kicad_sch sheets and .kicad_pcb board.
- Install on ArchieOS: `pacman -S kicad kicad-library`
- Install on Ubuntu: `add-apt-repository ppa:kicad/kicad-10.0-releases && apt install kicad`
- Install on Windows: `winget install KiCad.KiCad`
- Through: [KiCad S-expression files](https://dev-docs.kicad.org/en/file-formats/), [kicad-cli](https://docs.kicad.org/10.0/en/cli/cli.html), [KiCad IPC API (protobuf over NNG), for live edits in an open board](https://dev-docs.kicad.org/en/apis-and-binding/ipc-api/) (planned)
- GUI on the Stage (`kicad`, `eeschema`, `pcbnew`, `org.kicad.kicad`): Drawing new circuitry, interactive routing, placing footprints, Update PCB from Schematic (F8), and any dialog; check the result with kicad_erc, kicad_drc and kicad_render.
- Guide: [`bridges/kicad/SKILL.md`](../../bridges/kicad/SKILL.md)
- End-to-end tests: `ARCHIE_BRIDGE_E2E=kicad cargo test -p archie-bridges --test kicad_e2e`

| Tool | Changes files | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `kicad_projects` | no | KiCad projects |
| `kicad_schematic` | no | What a schematic sheet holds |
| `kicad_board` | no | What a board holds |
| `kicad_netlist` | no | The nets of a design |
| `kicad_erc` | no | Electrical rules check |
| `kicad_drc` | no | Design rules check |
| `kicad_set_fields` | yes | Set a part's fields |
| `kicad_export` | yes | Export manufacturing and documentation files |
| `kicad_render` | yes | Render the board in 3D |
| `kicad_version` | no | KiCad's version |

### video

List and probe media, then render a timeline of cut clips, titles, music and fades to MP4, with a Kdenlive-openable project beside it.

- Works in: A media folder: the sources to cut from; renders go to its renders/ folder.
- Install on ArchieOS: `pacman -S mlt ffmpeg kdenlive`
- Install on Ubuntu: `apt install melt ffmpeg kdenlive`
- Install on Windows: `winget install KDE.Kdenlive`
- Through: [MLT XML](https://www.mltframework.org/docs/mltxml/), [melt](https://www.mltframework.org/docs/melt/), [ffprobe](https://ffmpeg.org/ffprobe.html)
- GUI on the Stage (`org.kde.kdenlive`, `kdenlive`, `org.shotcut.Shotcut`): Effects, transitions and colour work the timeline does not describe: open the rendered project in Kdenlive on the Stage and continue there.
- Guide: [`bridges/video/SKILL.md`](../../bridges/video/SKILL.md)
- End-to-end tests: `ARCHIE_BRIDGE_E2E=video cargo test -p archie-bridges --test video_e2e`

| Tool | Changes files | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `video_sources` | no | Media files |
| `video_probe` | no | What a media file holds |
| `video_render` | yes | Render a video |

## Adding a bridge

Follow [`docs/BRIDGES.md`](../BRIDGES.md): `archie-bridges new <id>` writes the skeleton, and the procedure says what a bridge must have before it is listed here.
